output.population: Seven healthy volunteers (mean age 34.1 years, SD=9.8; n=3 females, n=6 Caucasians); four also joined an open-label replication protocol
output.summary: Randomized cross-over precision functional mapping study of psilocybin versus methylphenidate in healthy volunteers, with baseline, post-dose and longitudinal imaging: resting-state and task fMRI, structural MRI, diffusion imaging and subjective-experience assessments.
